description: Upgrade your DIY and professional toolkit with the Compact Brushless Cordless Impact Drill. Designed for efficiency and power, this 20V brushless drill offers high-speed drilling and fastening with a no-load speed of 0-500/0-2000 RPM and a maximum impact rate of 30,000 bpm. Its robust 55Nm torque and adjustable 22+1+1 settings allow precise control for different materials and applications. The drill features a 13mm metal chuck, mechanical 2-speed gear and spindle lock function for secure, easy bit changes. Integrated LED work light ensures visibility in dark corners, while the LED battery indicator keeps you informed about remaining charge. This all-in-one kit comes with 2 x 2.0Ah battery packs, 1 charger, 47-piece accessory set, 3 masonry drill bits and a convenient carrying case—making it perfect for home improvement, woodworking, metalworking and construction tasks. Compact, lightweight and powerful, it is the ideal cordless drill for both professional and DIY users.
